chapter: Critical Thinking, Inference, and Language Usage

questions.question: Read: 'Dark clouds covered the sky. Mia grabbed her umbrella before leaving.' Why did Mia take her umbrella?
Which sentence makes the most sense?
Read: 'Ben studied every night for a week.' What is most likely to happen?
options: He may do well on the test
questions.answer: He may do well on the test

questions.question: Which word best completes the sentence? 'The baby was so ____ that she fell asleep quickly.'
Read: 'The ice cream melted in the sun.' Why did it melt?
Read: 'The classroom was silent when the principal walked in.' What does 'silent' mean?
Which sentence is the best choice for a thank-you note?
options: Thank you for the wonderful gift.
questions.answer: Thank you for the wonderful gift.

questions.question: Read: 'Lena put on a coat, gloves, and boots.' What can you infer about the weather?
Which word best completes the sentence? 'The firefighter was very ____ because he entered the burning building to help others.'
Read: 'After watering the plant every day, Sam noticed new leaves growing.' What caused the plant to grow?
Read: 'The soccer field was muddy, so the game was canceled.' Why was the game canceled?
options: The field was not safe to play on
questions.answer: The field was not safe to play on

questions.question: Which sentence gives the strongest clue that someone is nervous?
options: Her hands were shaking before the speech.
questions.answer: Her hands were shaking before the speech.

questions.question: Read: 'Daniel saved part of his allowance every week. After six months, he bought a tablet.' What helped Daniel buy the tablet?
Which sentence is the most polite way to ask for help?
